The intracellular environment is primed for anabolism following intense training, and it is conceivable that large transient spikes in GH enhance the remodeling process. Moreover, recombinant GH is composed solely of the 22-kDa isoform (61), whereas more than 100 molecular isoforms of GH are produced endogenously (154). These isoforms peak in the early post-exercise period, and a majority of those isoforms are of the non-22-kDa variety (61).
